meta.data_description_zh:
1. 衛生福利部為落實出生通報工作，訂定「出生通報作業計畫」，多次與「兒童福利
法」主管機關內政部會議協商，由內政部於民國83年9月13日定案公布「出生
通報作業流程」。同年12 月28日由衛生福利部公告發布新修訂之「出生證明書」
及「死產證明書」，並於民國84年3月起實施紙本出生通報作業。
2. 民國 93 年起醫療單位改行網路通報不再使用紙本、而戶政聯仍採兩種通報方式
並行。經國健署持續與內政部戶政司協調整合，民國 94 年起全面實施網路出生
通報，完全免除紙本之寄送。
3. 民國92年5月28日「兒童福利法」及「少年福利法」合併修正公布為「兒童及
少年福利法」，其中第 13 條規定：「胎兒出生後 7 日內，接生人應將其出生之相
關資料通報戶政及衛生主管機關備查」。
4. 民國100年11月30日修正公布「兒童及少年福利與權益保障法」，其中第14條
規定：「胎兒出生後 7 日內，接生人應將其出生之相關資料通報衛生主管機關備
查；其為死產者，亦同」。另非在醫院、診所或助產所出生無法取得出生證明書者，
應提憑醫療機構開立之 DNA 親子鑑定報告書或領有證照之醫護人員所開立之出
生通報書，辦理出生登記。
5. 不同於「出生登記」，「出生通報」為所有在我國出生(不限國籍)之
a.活產新生兒；
b.懷孕≧20週或體重≧500公克之死產兒。
(引述國民健康署出生通報背景說明)
meta.notes_zh:
1. 一位新生兒為一筆資料。
2. 本資料係全國各接生醫療院所通報之「出生證明書」、「死產證明書」與「出生通
報書」資料。
3. 統計項目包含產婦背景資料（國籍、居住地）及懷孕情形（危險因子或特殊處置）、
新生兒資料（出生體重、胎別、先天缺陷註記等）、產婦配偶資料（國籍、戶籍地）
等欄位。
4. 104 年 7 月 1 日起，出生通報系統之新生兒先天性缺陷代碼改以 ICD-10-CM 通
報。然批次轉檔醫院因院內系統調整，給予三個月修改緩衝期，故104年7月至
meta.data_description_en:
1. To implement birth notification work, the Ministry of Health and Welfare drew up the "Birth Notification Operations Plan" and held repeated
consultations with the Ministry of the Interior, the competent authority of the "Child Welfare
Act"; the Ministry of the Interior finalized and promulgated the "Birth
Notification Operating Procedure" on 13 September 1994 (ROC 83). On 28 December of the same year the Ministry of Health and Welfare announced the newly revised "Birth Certificate" and "Stillbirth Certificate", and paper birth notification was implemented from March 1995 (ROC 84).
2. From 2004 (ROC 93), medical units switched to online notification and no longer used paper, while the household registration copy continued to use both notification methods
in parallel. After the Health Promotion Administration continued to coordinate and integrate with the Department of Household Registration, Ministry of the Interior, online birth
notification was fully implemented from 2005 (ROC 94), completely eliminating the mailing of paper forms.
3. On 28 May 2003 (ROC 92), the "Child Welfare Act" and the "Juvenile Welfare Act" were merged, amended and promulgated as the "Child and
Youth Welfare Act", Article 13 of which provides: "Within 7 days after a fetus is born, the birth attendant shall report the relevant birth
information to the household registration and health authorities for the record."
4. On 30 November 2011 (ROC 100), the "Protection of Children and Youths Welfare and Rights Act" was amended and promulgated, Article 14
of which provides: "Within 7 days after a fetus is born, the birth attendant shall report the relevant birth information to the health authority for
the record; the same applies to stillbirths." In addition, for births not in a hospital, clinic or midwifery clinic where a birth certificate cannot be obtained,
a DNA parentage test report issued by a medical institution or a birth notification form issued by licensed medical or nursing personnel must be presented
to handle the birth registration.
5. Unlike "birth registration", "birth notification" applies to all of the following born in Taiwan (regardless of nationality):
a. live-born newborns;
b. stillbirths at 20 or more weeks of gestation or with a birth weight of 500 g or more.
(Quoted from the Health Promotion Administration's background description of birth notification)
meta.notes_en: 1. Each newborn is one record. 2. This data comes from the 'birth certificate', 'stillbirth certificate', and 'birth notification' reported by delivery facilities nationwide. 3. Statistical items include maternal background data (nationality, residence) and pregnancy conditions (risk factors or special procedures), newborn data (birth weight, plurality, congenital-defect flag, etc.), and maternal spouse data (nationality, household registration). 4. From 1 July 2015 (ROC 104), newborn congenital-defect codes in the birth-notification system were changed to ICD-10-CM. Hospitals doing batch transfers were given a three-month buffer for system adjustment, so from July 2015...
